newsitem.title: USA: Williams Coal Seam sets lower payout.
newsitem.headline: Williams Coal Seam sets lower payout.

text.p: Williams Coal Seam Gas Royalty Trust said Wednesday that it has declared a quarterly cash distribution of $0.472711, payable August 29 to unitholders of record August 14.

The distribution per unit decreased from $0.617428 in the preceding quarter mainly as a result of decreased payments from its farmout properties and prior period adjustments of federal unit acreage expansion, said the company.
It also said that unitholders of record on August 14 will be entitled to estimated tax credits of $0.51 per unit under Section 29 of the Internal Revenue Code.
